entities.summary: Jörg Eberle is a Swiss former professional ice hockey player. He competed with the Switzerland men's national ice hockey team at both the 1988 and 1992 Winter Olympic Games, as well as the 1992 and 1993 Men's World Ice Hockey Championships.
